newsitem.title: USA: Xpedite buyout offer extended to 1700 EDT.
newsitem.headline: Xpedite buyout offer extended to 1700 EDT.

text.p: Xpedite Systems Inc, a developer of fax and electronic mail distribution services, said members of its management team and their partners agreed to extend an offer to buy Xpedite until Thursday, July 17 at 1700 EDT / 2100 GMT.
The original buyout offer of $22.50 a share was made February 7 by Xpedite managers, along with UBS Partners LLC, an affiliate of Union Bank of Switzerland and Fenway Partners Inc.
On Monday, the offer was extended until July 16.

The offer was extended again after Xpedite agreed not to solicit or take any action to facilitate any further offers to acquire Xpedite and to reimburse the buyout group's reasonable out-of-pocket expenses incurred from July 12 until July 17.
